checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add polarity inversion for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: The toolset can negate pitch (invert) and reverse audio (reverse-wav) but cannot flip sample polarity, a standard phase-cancellation utility.
impact_assessment.benefits: polarity negates every sample in place with exact double-application identity, preserving frame count and sample rate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sign of every sample must flip, applying twice must be byte-identical even at the i16 extreme, invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use wrapping i16 negation in the byte-vector module, add tests for sign flip, double identity and length, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 319 tests green; sign flips, byte-exact double inversion at i16 extreme and header preservation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-polarity' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add score overlay (parallel superposition)

impact_assessment.why: concat lays scores end to end and mix overlays rendered audio, but there is no way to superimpose two editable scores at their own absolute beats.
impact_assessment.benefits: overlay unions the note lists of several scores without shifting starts, sorts them deterministically by start and pitch, and keeps the first score's settings.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: starts must be unchanged, note count is the sum, ordering stable, first score settings win, output round-trips, empty input fails; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for start preservation, ordering and round-trip, a CLI command taking two or more scores, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 324 tests green; start preservation, stable ordering and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-overlay' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV health diagnostics

impact_assessment.why: analyze reports peak and RMS but not clipping, silence, DC offset, zero crossings or crest factor, which are needed to judge a rendered file.
impact_assessment.benefits: health prints those deterministic metrics for any Coda WAV, with exact counts and stable formatting.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: counts must be exact on crafted signals, crest factor and DC stable, silence finite, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests pinning the full deterministic report on two crafted signals, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a pedal-point drone transform

impact_assessment.why: Harmonize adds voices per note but there is no way to anchor a score with one sustained bass note spanning its whole length.
impact_assessment.benefits: pedal appends a single drone at the score's first beat covering its full span, with chosen pitch and velocity and no changes to existing notes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: pitch must parse, velocity 0..1, span must be positive, existing notes untouched, output round-trips; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for span, pitch, velocity and preservation, a CLI command with --note/--velocity, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add pitch snapping to a scale

impact_assessment.why: quantize snaps note timing to a grid but there is no way to snap pitches into a key, so hand-written melodies cannot be made diatonic.
impact_assessment.benefits: snap-scale moves every sounding pitch to the nearest degree of the chosen scale and root, preserving rhythm and timbre as editable source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: root must parse, scale must be valid, nearest degree with lower-on-tie, results in MIDI range, round-trip and rests skipped; dependency: std only, reuse gen::Scale; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for degree snapping, tie-breaking, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command reusing --scale/--root, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 339 tests green; nearest-degree snapping, tie-breaking and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-snap-scale' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV splice at a time offset

impact_assessment.why: pad inserts silence and mix adds signals, but there is no way to insert one WAV into another at a chosen time while keeping the original tail.
impact_assessment.benefits: splice places a WAV at an exact frame offset inside another, shifting the remaining audio unchanged, with zero-padding beyond the source end.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rates must match, offset non-negative and rounded to frames, head/tail bytes preserved, gap zero-filled, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for insertion, padding, rate validation and exact frame counts, a two-WAV CLI command with --at, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 344 tests green; exact insertion, zero padding and tail preservation pinned by byte tests
